blocks.text: Filipino actress-fashion personality Heart Evangelista was overwhelmed with gratitude after being given the Fashion Icon award at Harper’s Bazaar’s Women of the Year 2026 in Thailand. Evangelista made a quick trip to Thailand to personally accept the accolade at the ceremony organized by Harper’s Bazaar Thailand and held in Bangkok on Wednesday, Nov. 18. “Never in my wildest dreams did I imagine being recognized as Fashion Icon of the Year by Harper’s Bazaar Thailand!” she captioned the video on her Instagram page on Thursday, Nov. 19. “What an incredibly special moment and one I will treasure for a lifetime!” She also expressed […]...
